import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    if n == 0:
        return
    arr1 = list(map(int, data[1].split()))
    arr2 = list(map(int, data[2].split()))
    arr1 = arr1[:n]
    arr2 = arr2[:n]
    res = [a + b for a, b in zip(arr1, arr2)]
    print(' '.join(map(str, res)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
